title: 第七章 又来一个魔教分支第八章 残阳七式
content_zh:
“啊！”
黑衣人惨叫一声，将长剑在面前舞成了一团银光，飞身而退。
落在脸庞皮肤上的也就罢了，但落在眼睛里的飞灰却迷住了自己双眼，令自己目难视物。
然后他就听王昱说道，“此乃我家秘传的追魂夺命灭形散，见血封喉，腐肉蚀骨，只要三十息内没有用水清洗，便要骨肉腐烂，一命呜呼。”
“小狗！我信了你的邪！”黑衣人破口大骂，“你这明明就是石灰，若是见水，我这对眼睛就瞎了！”
“额？”王昱一愣，“你知道哈？”
紫菱扑哧一笑，李云岫也不禁莞尔，然后轻轻挥手，两枚金针便没入黑衣人眼中。
黑衣人再次惨叫，翻身就要逃走。
但他快，李云岫也不慢，身形一掠就到了他的身后，伸出纤纤玉手，按在了他的后心，内力一吐便震断了他的心脉。
黑衣人口中狂喷鲜血，倒地身亡。
王昱松了口气，然后又支棱起来，游目四顾，“不会还有人吧？”
晚风习习，落叶簌簌，再无一丝人声。
“看来是没有了。”李云岫也松了口气，一日三惊，即便是她，也有些心累神疲。
……
令众禁卫寻找工具，在后院去挖两个深坑，将地窖中的祖孙搬出来，准备与老樵夫祖孙、黑衣人这一伙杀手分别埋葬。
埋葬之前，当然要摸尸。
“一瓶毒药，一瓶解药，还有十二把带毒的飞镖和三十张金叶子。”紫菱喜笑颜开，“没想到这老头儿还挺有钱的。”
紫菱在摸尸，李云岫和王昱就在她身边。
“你刚刚说的剑道理论，是从哪里听来的？”李云岫问道。
“从小说上看来的。”王昱说道。

此方世界的民间已经颇为繁华，民众识字率也起来了，除了文人典籍之外，各种戏曲、小说、绘本也应运而生。
“小说里有一位纵横天下的绝世高手，弱冠前用的就是凌厉刚猛，无坚不摧的宝剑。”
王昱继续说道，“三十岁前用的是一柄软剑，误伤义士之后弃之深谷，改用一柄重剑，四十前持之横行天下。
小说然后介绍他四十岁后不滞于物，草木竹石均可为剑，自此精进，渐入无剑胜有剑之境。”
“无剑胜有剑？”李云岫皱眉凝思，“一般小说的作者就算练武，成就也不会太高，最多写写故事人物，编些武功，哪能写出什么武学道理，虽然这理论听起来挺玄妙，但未必契合实际。”
想了想，李云岫还是问道，“这本小说叫什么名字？”
“我忘了。”王昱理直气壮的道。
李云岫，“……”
李云岫略一沉吟，明眸深邃如水，深深的看向王昱，“你是怎么想到利用虚则实之，实则虚之，先用言语吓唬他，又用柴条吸引他的注意力，最后用石灰一击命中的？”
严老意外身死，虽然她很快就用计拿住了老樵夫，但黑衣人出现时，她的确是没有把握。
虽然她也有自己的底牌，武功也从未真正的显露人前，但既然自己之前没有发现黑衣人的踪迹，就说明对方的武功也并不弱。
自己第一时间示敌以弱，表露慌乱，手上又藏了从未显于人前的金针暗器，但对方究竟会不会大意中计，李云岫也并不确定。
相对于自己凭借女子之身的常规应对，王昱的应对却令李云岫惊艳。
虽然赵昱的纨绔之名响彻京城，但作为先天宗师的儿子，还是有一点威慑力的，再加上言辞之间玄妙难懂，一时之间竟将黑衣人唬住了。
赵昱平日在京城是用剑的，按理说他长剑不会离手，但此时面对随时可能发生的刺杀，不仅长剑不在手边，还拿着一支柴条当剑，是个人都会惊疑不定。
但黑衣人作为要杀王昱的人，那是一定要对王昱动手的，但试探时一定会小心谨慎，并且将全副心神集中到王昱手中的柴条上。
然而黑衣人试探之下，就算心里能猜到各种可能，也绝不会猜到王昱手中的柴条竟然如此脆弱。
趁着黑衣人一愣神的功夫，王昱就可以凭借自己初得的浅薄内力扬起石灰，在如此近的距离内以迅雷不及掩耳之势将石灰撒到对方的眼睛里。
李云岫眼尖，看到王昱几乎在黑衣人长剑触碰柴条的一瞬间便松开了柴条，以免被对方的内力震伤，可见其小心谨慎。
于是，一个不逊色于自己的武林高手，便被他以泼皮无赖一般的打架手段拿下了。

李云岫有些感慨，自己的女状元之名名传天下，但今日却被这个初出茅庐的新人救了两次。
content_en:
"Ah!"
The man in black screamed, danced his sword into a ball of silver light in front of him, and flew away.
It only landed on the skin of his face, but the fly ash that landed in his eyes fascinated him, making it difficult to see.
Then he heard Wang Yu say, "This is my family's secret soul-chasing, life-killing, form-destroying powder. Blood seals the throat and corrodes the flesh and bones. As long as it is not washed with water within thirty breaths, the flesh and bones will rot and you will die."
"Puppy! I believed you!" The man in black yelled, "You are obviously just lime. If it comes into contact with water, my eyes will be blind!"
"Uh?" Wang Yu was stunned, "You know, huh?"
Zi Ling burst into laughter, and Li Yunxiu couldn't help but smile. Then he waved his hand gently, and the two golden needles disappeared into the eyes of the man in black.
The man in black screamed again, turned over and was about to escape.
But he was fast, and Li Yunxiu was not slow either. She reached behind him in a flash, stretched out her slender hand and pressed it on the back of his heart, breaking his heart veins with a burst of inner strength.
The man in black spurted blood and fell to the ground dead.
Wang Yu breathed a sigh of relief, then stood up again and looked around, "Is there anyone else?"
The evening breeze was blowing, the fallen leaves were rustling, and there was no sound of human beings.
"It seems there is no more." Li Yunxiu also breathed a sigh of relief. She was shocked three times a day. Even she was a little tired.
…
He ordered the guards to find tools, dig two deep pits in the backyard, move the grandparents and grandchildren out of the cellar, and prepare to bury them separately with the old woodcutter, the grandfather and the men in black and other killers.
Before burial, of course, the body must be touched.
"A bottle of poison, a bottle of antidote, twelve poisonous darts and thirty gold leaves." Zi Ling beamed, "I didn't expect this old man to be quite rich."
Zi Ling was touching the body, with Li Yunxiu and Wang Yu beside her.
"Where did you hear the sword theory you just mentioned?" Li Yunxiu asked.
"It seems from the novel." Wang Yu said.
The folk in this world are already quite prosperous, and the literacy rate of the people has also increased. In addition to literati classics, various operas, novels, and picture books have also emerged as the times require.
"In the novel, there is a peerless master who dominates the world. Before he is weak, he uses a fierce and indestructible sword."
Wang Yu continued, "Before the age of thirty, I used a soft sword. After accidentally injuring a righteous man, I abandoned it in a deep valley. I switched to a heavy sword. Forty years ago, I wielded it and went rampant in the world.
The novel then introduces that after the age of forty, he no longer stagnates with objects. Plants, trees, bamboos and stones can be turned into swords. From then on, he improves and gradually enters the realm where no sword is better than having a sword. "
"No sword is better than having a sword?" Li Yunxiu frowned and thought, "Generally, even if the authors of novels practice martial arts, their achievements will not be very high. They can only write story characters and make up some martial arts, but they can't write any martial arts principles. Although this theory sounds mysterious, it may not be in line with reality."
After thinking for a while, Li Yunxiu asked, "What is the name of this novel?"
"I forgot." Wang Yu said confidently.
Li Yunxiu, "..."
Li Yunxiu pondered for a moment, and looked at Wang Yu deeply with his bright eyes as deep as water, "How did you come up with the idea of using the imaginary to make the real and the real to make the imaginary? First use words to scare him, then use sticks to attract his attention, and finally hit him with a blow of lime?"
Old Yan died unexpectedly. Although she quickly caught the old woodcutter with a trick, she was really not sure when the man in black appeared.
Although she also has her own trump card and her martial arts has never been truly revealed to others, since she has not found any trace of the man in black before, it means that the opponent's martial arts are not weak.
He immediately showed his weakness to the enemy, showed his panic, and hid a golden needle hidden weapon that had never been shown to others, but Li Yunxiu was not sure whether the other party would fall into the trap accidentally.
Compared with his conventional response by virtue of being a woman, Wang Yu's response surprised Li Yunxiu.
Although Zhao Yu's reputation as a playboy resounds throughout the capital, as the son of the innate master, he still has some intimidating power.It was so mysterious and difficult to understand that it frightened the man in black for a moment.
Zhao Yu usually used a sword in the capital, and it was logical that he would never leave his hand with the long sword. But at this time, facing an assassination that could happen at any time, not only was the long sword not at hand, but he was also holding a stick of firewood as a sword. Everyone would be shocked and confused.
But as the person who wanted to kill Wang Yu, the man in black must take action against Wang Yu, but he would be cautious when testing and focus all his attention on the stick in Wang Yu's hand.
However, under the temptation of the man in black, even if he could guess various possibilities in his mind, he would never guess that the stick in Wang Yu's hand was so fragile.
Taking advantage of the moment when the man in black was stunned, Wang Yu could use his new inner strength to lift up the lime and sprinkle it into the opponent's eyes at lightning speed from such a close distance.
Li Yunxiu's sharp eyes saw that Wang Yu let go of the stick almost the moment the man in black's long sword touched it, to avoid being injured by the opponent's internal force, which showed that he was cautious.
As a result, a martial arts master who was not inferior to him was defeated by him using fighting methods like a rogue.
Li Yunxiu felt a little emotional. His reputation as the number one female champion was spread all over the world, but today he was saved twice by this fledgling newcomer.
